requirements.requirement_text: **Normative owner directive:** ALL development of the new SmartSIHub platform SHALL be initiated, orchestrated, observed and accepted through the *currently running* `https://smartaihub.app` Autonomous Implements / Autonomous Mini App Creator facilities, using their existing SPEC-224 Job/Run, Runner, Workspace, Harness and deployment authorities. `smartaihub.app` is the **temporary development control plane**, not the new SaaS Core implementation or the new production domain. This rule applies to source changes, builds, tests, release requests, UAT and repair work; executors may run CLI internally as delegated tools. An emergency out-of-band repair is permitted ONLY when the old UI/control path is nonfunctional; reconcile its exact SHA/Run/receipts back into the canonical record as soon as recovery permits. Never claim that a task was executed through the UI unless actual Run evidence confirms it.

requirements.requirement_text: The development loop SHALL be: **Goal entered on old website → durable Run and owned Debian workspace → implement/test/build → real `aimarkethubs.com` UAT → scoped `smartsihub.com` Cloudflare beta when appropriate → user feedback → automatic child repair/continue**. A defect in the existing control plane becomes an **in-scope bootstrap repair task** for the affected operation, not a reason to abandon the migration or create another approval system. Preserve task identity, source SHA, logs and work artifacts through restart/disconnect; no silent success claims. The new autonomous implementer becomes the primary authority only after it has completed real development tasks and recovery/rollback tests; user-visible traffic switches selectively, with the old tool retained as fallback until stable. See SPEC-324 and [roadmap](../../../docs/smartsihub-r1.4/ROADMAP-AUTONOMOUS-IMPLEMENTATION.md).
